## Overview
### Introduction to Llama 3.3 70B Instruct
The Llama 3.3 70B Instruct model, released by Meta on 2024-12-06, is a standard, open-source language model designed to process and generate human-like text. This model is part of the Llama family, known for its versatility and performance in various natural language processing (NLP) tasks. With its architecture based on a transformer model, Llama 3.3 70B Instruct is capable of handling a wide range of applications, from coding and analysis to chatbots and agents. Its primary strengths include its ability to understand and follow instructions, generate coherent text, and perform function calling, making it a valuable tool for developers.

### Technical Specifications and Pricing
Technically, Llama 3.3 70B Instruct boasts a context window of 131,072 tokens and can produce output up to 8,192 tokens, with a knowledge cutoff of 2023-12. The model's pricing is based on input and output tokens, with costs of $0.59 per 1M tokens for input and $0.79 per 1M tokens for output. For developers, understanding these specifications and pricing is crucial for planning and budgeting projects. The model's capabilities, including text, function calling, JSON mode, streaming, and system prompts, make it suitable for a variety of use cases such as coding, analysis, summarization, and chatbot development. Benchmarks show strong performance, with scores of 86.0 on MMLU, 88.0 on HumanEval, 1248 on LMSYS Arena ELO, and 95.0 on GSM8K.
